cd /testbed && patch -p1 <<'PATCH'
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1116,6 +1116,38 @@
     } {*NOPERM*channel*}
 }
 
+set server_path [tmpdir "replica.acl"]
+exec cp -f tests/assets/user.acl $server_path
+start_server {tags {acl repl external:skip}} {
+    set primary [srv 0 client]
+    set primary_host [srv 0 host]
+    set primary_port [srv 0 port]
+    start_server [list overrides [list "dir" $server_path "aclfile" "user.acl"]] {
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica preserves replication and reloads users} {
+            r REPLICAOF $primary_host $primary_port
+            wait_for_sync r
+
+            set alice [r ACL GETUSER alice]
+            r ACL SETUSER alice -get
+            assert_equal OK [r ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal $alice [r ACL GETUSER alice]
+
+            set rd [valkey_deferring_client]
+            $rd AUTH alice alice
+            assert_equal OK [$rd read]
+            $rd SUBSCRIBE test
+            assert_equal {subscribe test 1} [$rd read]
+            assert_equal OK [r ACL LOAD]
+            r PUBLISH test message
+            assert_equal {message test message} [$rd read]
+            $rd close
+
+            r ACL SETUSER default -set
+            $primary SET acl-replication-key value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary r
+            assert_equal value [r GET acl-replication-key]
+            assert_equal up [s master_link_status]
+        }
+    }
+}
+
 set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
 exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
 exec cp -f tests/assets/default.conf $server_path
PATCH

final_message: Fixed the crash: `ACL LOAD` dereferenced a NULL user on the replica’s primary connection, which intentionally bypasses ACLs. Reloading now skips ACL-exempt connections while updating ordinary clients normally. Added regression coverage for user reloads and continued replication.
